# SOS Custom Gutters

> SOS Custom Gutters is a Kelowna, BC-based gutter and eavestrough company owned and operated by Christian Bravo, who has over 20 years of hands-on experience. We provide residential and commercial gutter installation, cleaning, repair, and leaf guard services throughout Kelowna and the Okanagan Valley. Free quotes. Bilingual service in English and Spanish. Call or text 250-718-4567.

## Company

- Business name: SOS Custom Gutters
- Owner: Christian Bravo
- Phone: 250-718-4567 (call or text)
- Website: https://soscustomgutters.com
- Hours: Monday–Friday 7:00 AM–6:00 PM, Saturday 8:00 AM–2:00 PM
- Languages: English, Spanish (Hablamos Español)
- Service area: Kelowna, West Kelowna, Vernon, Penticton, Lake Country, Summerland, Peachland, Oliver, Osoyoos, Armstrong, Enderby, Keremeos, Okanagan Falls, Merritt, Salmon Arm, Sicamous, Rock Creek, Midway, and the wider Okanagan Valley, Thompson-Nicola, Shuswap, and Boundary regions of British Columbia, Canada.

## Services

- [Gutter Installation](https://soscustomgutters.com/gutter-installation-kelowna.html): Custom seamless gutter and eavestrough installation for residential and commercial properties.
- [Gutter Cleaning](https://soscustomgutters.com/gutter-cleaning-kelowna.html): Gutter and eavestrough cleaning and maintenance. Pricing: $199 small home, $349 medium home, $499+ large home. Free estimates.
- [Gutter Repair](https://soscustomgutters.com/eavestrough-repair-west-kelowna.html): Eavestrough repair for damaged, sagging, or leaking gutters in West Kelowna and the Okanagan.
- [Commercial Gutters](https://soscustomgutters.com/commercial-gutters-okanagan.html): Continuous eavestrough systems for commercial and multi-housing properties across the Okanagan.
- [Leaf Guards](https://soscustomgutters.com/leaf-guards-kelowna.html): Leaf gutter guards and gutter protection systems to reduce debris buildup and cleaning frequency.
